dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent O-shaped structures exhibit irregular, non-linear perimeters with sharp gradient transitions from the low-intensity dark brown dorsal background to high-intensity tan circular perimeters. The interior of these structures often returns to a lower-intensity dark core, creating a concentric ring appearance.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, dark-core clusters concentrated on the anterior-lateral region; pixels are tightly packed with minimal inter-blob spacing, appearing as a mottled texture of low-intensity points against a lighter tan sub-matrix.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the five most prominent mid-lateral annuli form an elongated, irregular pentagonal spatial relationship oriented along the longitudinal axis of the torso, with a secondary triangular cluster of smaller blobs located near the anterior pectoral fold.
